description: getInvoiceDetails: Get detailed information about a specific invoice including line items. Requires authentication.

invoiceId.description: The identifier of the invoice to fetch, as returned by listInvoices.

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.
